rejection.code_malformed: "{field}" is not a valid code. Use lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
rejection.date_malformed: {field} is not a date. Use the form YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.wall_clock_malformed: {field} is not a time of day. Use the form HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.
rejection.zone_unknown: This system does not recognise that time zone.
rejection.text_requires_both_languages: {field} is needed in both English and Arabic.
rejection.metadata_entry_too_long: The metadata entry "{key}" is too long.
rejection.minutes_out_of_range: {field} is not a sensible number of minutes.
rejection.period_ends_before_it_begins: The end of the period is before its start.
rejection.event_kind_unknown: That is not a kind of time event this product understands.
rejection.event_source_unknown: That is not a source a time event can come from.
rejection.location_malformed: A punch location needs both a latitude and a longitude, and both have to be real coordinates.
rejection.shift_kind_unknown: That is not a kind of shift this product understands.
rejection.shift_not_draft: A published shift never changes. Draft the next version instead.
rejection.shift_not_published: This shift has not been published, so nobody can be measured against it.
rejection.shift_has_no_work_segment: A shift with no working time would expect nothing of anybody.
rejection.flex_window_needs_a_flexible_shift: Only a flexible shift has a window to arrive within.
rejection.core_hours_need_a_flexible_shift: Only a flexible shift has core hours.
rejection.core_hours_incomplete: Core hours need both a start and an end.
rejection.segment_kind_unknown: A segment is either working time or a break.
rejection.segment_sequence_out_of_range: That is not a valid position within the shift.
rejection.schedule_not_draft: A published schedule never changes. Draft the next version instead.
rejection.schedule_not_published: This schedule has not been published, so nobody can be assigned to it.
rejection.schedule_has_no_working_day: A schedule whose cycle holds no shift would expect nothing of anybody.
rejection.cycle_length_out_of_range: A schedule cycle has to be between one day and a year.
rejection.cycle_position_out_of_range: That position is outside this schedule's cycle.
rejection.roster_kind_unknown: That is not a kind of rostered day this product understands.
rejection.roster_shift_reference_mismatch: A rostered shift names the shift; a rest day, a holiday and an off-site day do not.
rejection.rounding_mode_unknown: That is not a way of rounding this product understands.
rejection.policy_not_draft: A published policy never changes. Draft the next version instead.
rejection.policy_not_published: This policy has not been published.
rejection.no_policy_in_force: No attendance policy is in force on that date, so there is nothing to calculate against. Publish one first.
rejection.day_transition_not_permitted: An attendance day cannot move from {from} to {to}.
rejection.day_not_approved: This day has not been signed off.
rejection.blocking_exceptions_open: This day cannot be signed off while something on it is unresolved.
rejection.exception_already_concluded: This exception has already been dealt with.
rejection.correction_kind_unknown: That is not a kind of correction this product understands.
rejection.correction_target_mismatch: Amending or removing an event names the event; adding one does not.
rejection.correction_proposal_incomplete: A correction has to say what the record should say instead.
rejection.correction_already_decided: This correction has already been decided.
rejection.correction_not_approved: This correction has not been approved.
rejection.correction_self_approval: A correction cannot be decided by the person who asked for it.
rejection.correction_not_yours_to_withdraw: Only the person who asked for a correction can withdraw it.
rejection.justification_required: A correction has to say what actually happened.

conflict.employment_ended: This employment had already ended on that date.
conflict.event_race_lost: Another submission of this punch landed first.
conflict.shift_code_taken: That shift code is already in use in this tenant.
conflict.schedule_code_taken: That schedule code is already in use in this tenant.
conflict.roster_entry_exists: This day is already rostered. Send the entry's version to replace it.
conflict.assignment_overlaps: An assignment already in force covers that period.
conflict.assignment_already_ended: That assignment already has an end date.
conflict.days_awaiting_recalculation: A day in this period is still waiting to be recalculated.
conflict.period_malformed: That is not a period this product can freeze.
conflict.import_too_large: That batch holds more rows than one request can carry. Split the file.
conflict.export_too_large: That range holds more days than one export can carry. Narrow the dates.

exception.absence_pending_explanation: Absent, and leave cannot yet be checked.
exception.unscheduled_attendance: Attended on a day nobody was expected.
exception.duplicate_punch: Two punches of the same kind, moments apart.
exception.invalid_punch: A punch that makes no sense where it is.
exception.clock_skew: The device clock disagreed with the server's.
exception.undertime: Worked less than the expected day.
exception.late_event_after_approval: A punch arrived after this day was signed off.

label.boundary.employment: No employment fact. No employee number, no status, no contracted hours, no manager and no person — ask Employment, as at a date.
label.boundary.leave: No leave. Where the record says the leave state is unknown, it means nobody could be asked — not that no leave exists.
label.boundary.location: No work location. A punch may carry coordinates a tenant chose to capture; there is no site, no geofence and no verdict.
label.boundary.money: No money. Overtime here is a candidate in minutes; what worked time is worth is Compensation's and Payroll's.
label.boundary.notifications: No notifications and no documents. Nothing here emails anybody or stores a file.
label.unavailable: The attendance service is unreachable or has not authorized this session.
